correctness.rationale: For 1<R<2, 1/R<s≤1, θ∈[0,1], exponential modes in the specified positive second-order recurrence give λ²=R(1−θ)cosh(t) λ+Rsθ cosh(2t), and the precisely defined speed is c(θ)=inf_{t>0}logλ/t. The weighted implicit differentiation in RESULT.md gives strictly positive gθ″(t), while gθ(0)>0 and its large-t linear asymptote has a coefficient Lθ<1; hence each cθ has a unique finite minimizer. At θ=0 the endpoint derivative switches at s_c(R)=R/(1+tanh² t_R), t_R tanh t_R−logcosh t_R=log R. For s≤s_c, a fixed-tilt test yields strict global superiority of θ=0, including equality via the nonstationary shifted tilt. For s>s_c the maximizing θ is interior; the vanishing θ-derivative fixes unique tilt τ=atanh(sqrt(R/s−1)), and monotone tilt derivative fixes unique θ_opt=(v−u)/(2z−u−v), speed v. Differentiating log s_c in the R(t) parametrization yields sech²t[t−tanh(2t)], with unique zero t*=0.957504024…, giving s_min=0.878135713950414…. Independent numerical minimizations across below/above regimes and the global floor agreed. The theorem is explicitly about the linear exponential-envelope functional, not nonlinear selected fronts.
